item.title: [Episode 18] "The System Has Identified the Enemy" ([18화] “시스템이 적을 식별했습니다”)
item.description:
[Episode 18] "The System Has Identified the Enemy" ([18화] “시스템이 적을 식별했습니다”)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Around 4 PM, the weather in the highlands changed without warning. Cold air currents, laden with moisture from the Sea of Okhotsk, climbed the slopes of the Taebaek Mountain Range and began to condense rapidly. (오후 4시 무렵, 고성의 기상이 예고 없이 뒤바뀌었다. 오호츠크해에서 습기를 머금고 밀려온 차가운 기류가 태백산맥의 사면을 타고 오르며 급격히 응결하기 시작했다.)

In just ten minutes, all the colors of the DMZ evaporated. The ridgelines that Sariel had vividly drawn in emerald green moments before vanished, and a white curtain, obscuring even a single inch ahead, swallowed the barbed wire fence. (불과 10분 만에 DMZ의 모든 색채가 증발했다. 방금 전까지 사리엘이 비취색으로 선명하게 그려냈던 능선들은 사라지고, 한 치 앞도 분간할 수 없는 백색의 장막이 철책을 집어삼켰다.)

It was a sea fog capable of blinding not only human eyes but also the clumsy eyes of machines. (인간의 눈은 물론, 어설픈 기계의 눈마저 멀게 만드는 해무(海霧)였다.)

Evan sat with a cold canned coffee in the nearby monitoring station, visualizing the invisible battlefield beyond the fog outside the window. Due to security regulations and the need to maintain fairness, on-site access was restricted during the competitor's demonstration time. (에반은 인근 대기소에서 차가운 캔커피를 쥔 채, 창밖의 안개 너머 보이지 않는 전장을 머릿속에 그렸다. 보안 규정과 공정성 유지를 위해 경쟁사 데모 시간에는 현장 입장이 제한되었다.)

"Alright, it's Sentinel's turn now." (“자, 이제 센티넬 차례입니다.”)

Inside the server room, the Woosung Industries-Sentinel consortium team stood before the console. The Sentinel technical team deployed the latest high-performance LiDAR sensors at the front of the demonstration area. LiDAR, which measures distance by the reflection time of emitted lasers, is equipment boasting precision down to 1 centimeter on a clear day. (서버실 안, 우성인더스트리-센티넬 컨소시엄 팀이 콘솔 앞에 섰다. 센티넬 기술팀은 최신형 고성능 라이다(LiDAR) 센서를 시연장 전면에 배치했다. 레이저를 쏘아 반사 시간으로 거리를 측정하는 라이다는, 맑은 날이라면 1cm 단위의 정밀도를 자랑하는 장비다.)

But in this extreme sea fog, everyone was on edge. (하지만 지금 같은 극한의 해무 앞에서, 모두가 긴장을 놓치 못했다.)

"Why is the data reception sensitivity like this?" (“데이터 수신 감도가 왜 이래?”)

Sentinel's lead engineer couldn't hide his bewildered expression as he typed on the keyboard. (센티넬 수석 엔지니어가 키보드를 두드리며 당황스러운 표정을 감추지 못했다.)

Laser pulses, striking moisture particles in the air, scattered in all directions before even reaching the target. The monitor was flooded with hundreds of thousands of meaningless data fragments. Sentinel's algorithm struggled, failing to distinguish this noise from actual objects. (공기 중 수분 입자에 부딪힌 레이저 펄스가 목표물에 닿기도 전에 사방으로 퍼져버렸다. 모니터에는 수십만 개의 무의미한 데이터 파편이 쏟아졌다. 센티넬의 알고리즘은 이 노이즈를 실제 물체와 구분하지 못하고 허우적댔다.)

"Lower the threshold! Reapply the noise filtering!" (“임계값 낮춰! 노이즈 필터링 다시 걸어!”)

The voice of the technical team leader dispatched from the U.S. headquarters grew urgent. The engineers' fingers moved busily over the keyboards, but the data on the screen spiraled out of control. (미국 본사에서 파견된 기술팀장의 목소리가 다급해졌다. 엔지니어들의 손가락이 키보드 위를 바쁘게 움직였지만, 화면 속 데이터는 통제 불능으로 치달았다.)

At that moment, Sentinel's perimeter interface flashed red with a warning sound. (그 순간, 센티넬의 경계 인터페이스가 경고음과 함께 붉게 점멸했다.)

BEEP—. BEEP—. (삐이이익—. 삐이이익—.)

[WARNING: UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT DETECTED] ([WARNING: UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT DETECTED])

[Identification Probability: North Korean Infantry 70.2%] ([식별 확률: 북한군 보병 (Infantry) 70.2%])

[Location: 50m forward, near GP Outpost 2] ([위치: 전방 50m, GP 2초소 인근])

It was a signal that a faint heat source had been detected in the middle of the thick fog. A 70% identification rate. A figure that, under engagement rules, would warrant immediate warning fire. (흐릿한 열원 하나가 짙은 안개 한복판에 포착되었다는 신호였다. 식별률 70퍼센트. 교전 수칙상 즉각적인 경고 사격을 고려해야 할 수치였다.)

A look of relief and tension crossed the face of the Woosung Industries executive simultaneously. He turned to look at Manager Park Gwan-gyu and reported. (우성인더스트리 임원의 얼굴에 안도와 긴장이 동시에 스쳤다. 그가 박관규 실장을 돌아보며 보고했다.)

"Chief, there are signs of an incursion. The system has identified the enemy." (“실장님, 침투 징후입니다. 시스템이 적을 식별했습니다.”)

But the expressions of the Sentinel engineers were different. Sweating nervously, they exchanged whispers. (하지만 센티넬 엔지니어들의 표정은 달랐다. 식은땀을 흘리며 서로 귓속말을 주고받았다.)

"Wait, is that thermal signature valid?" (“Wait, is that thermal signature valid?”)

"It's drifting... It might be the fog layer." (“It’s drifting... It might be the fog layer.”)

Chief Park continued taking notes with a calm demeanor. He minimized his movements and spoke even less. Unlike the excited Woosung executive, he checked the coordinates on the monitor with an emotionless gaze. (박 실장은 차분한 자세로 메모를 이어갔다. 동작은 최소한으로 줄이고, 말은 더 아꼈다. 흥분한 우성 임원과 달리, 감정을 뺀 눈빛으로 모니터 상의 좌표를 확인했다.)

"Let's verify it." (“검증해 보죠.”)

Chief Park picked up the radio. (박 실장이 무전기를 들었다.)

"The control center to the forward GP. The system has identified an unidentified object at a point 50 meters in front of your post, coordinates 3-Alpha sector. Please cross-check visually and with TOD." (“통제본부에서 전방 GP에 알린다. 현재 시스템상 귀소 전방 50미터 지점, 좌표 3-알파 구역에 미상 물체 식별됨. 육안 및 TOD 교차 확인 바란다.”)

Every breath in the server room seemed to stop. The static noise of the radio crackled for several seconds. (서버실의 모든 숨소리가 멈췄다. 치직거리는 무전기 노이즈가 수 초간 흘렀다.)

"...This is GP Outpost 2. Results of visual and night-vision scope check: no unusual activity. Forward visibility is zero, but no bio-signals detected on thermal equipment. Over." (“……여기는 GP 2초소. 육안 및 야간 투시경 확인 결과, 특이사항 없습니다. 전방 시야 제로 상태이나, 열상 장비상 생체 신호 잡히지 않습니다. 이상.")

A false detection. (오탐.)

The expressions of both Woosung and Sentinel executives hardened. Sentinel engineers muttered about a system error and frantically searched through the logs. (우성과 센티넬 임원 모두 표정이 굳었다. 센티넬 엔지니어들은 시스템 오류라 중얼거리며 황급히 로그를 뒤졌다.)

Sentinel's technical advisor loosened his tie and began to explain. (센티넬 측 기술고문이 넥타이를 느슨하게 풀며 해명에 나섰다.)

"Chief, this isn't equipment error. Even AI has to deal with uncertainty in such extreme weather. We applied a conservative safety design—in technical terms, a fail-safe logic—to alert for potential risks in advance. It's safer to raise a warning than to miss something." (“실장님, 이건 장비 오류가 아닙니다. AI도 이런 극한의 기상에서는 불확실성을 가질 수밖에 없습니다. 저희는 만약의 위험 가능성을 미리 알려주는 보수적 안전 설계, 전문 용어로 페일 세이프(Fail-safe) 로직을 적용한 겁니다. 놓치는 것보다 경고를 띄우는 게 안전하니까요.”)

Chief Park slowly set down the ballpoint pen he was holding onto the evaluation sheet. He raised his eyes and looked at the technical advisor. (박 실장은 들고 있던 볼펜을 평가표 위에 천천히 내려놓았다. 고개를 들어 기술고문을 응시했다.)

"The military does not call that 'safety.'" (“군에서는 그걸 ‘안전’이라 부르지 않습니다.”)

His voice was still flat. (목소리에는 여전히 높낮이가 없었다.)

"If this kind of conservative design goes off every night, soldiers will dismiss even real infiltration signals as machine errors and ignore them." (“매일 밤 이런 식의 보수적 설계가 울려대면, 병사들은 진짜 침투 신호조차 기계 오류로 치부하고 무시하게 되겠죠.”)

Chief Park picked up the pen again. (박 실장이 볼펜을 다시 집어 들었다.)

"That's what we call noise that induces operational failure." (“작전 실패를 유도하는 노이즈라는 겁니다.”)

The Sentinel team was speechless. More than yelling or shouting, nothing is more intimidating than a red line drawn by citing a regulation book. (센티넬 팀은 아무 말도 하지 못했다. 화를 내거나 소리를 지르는 것보다, 규정집을 들이대며 긋는 빨간 줄이 훨씬 무서운 법이다.)

It was the moment when the gap between what Sariel had proven and the error Sentinel had spewed out made the scoring for price meaningless. (사리엘이 증명한 사실과 센티넬이 내뱉은 오류 사이의 간극이, 가격이라는 배점을 이미 무의미하게 만들어 버린 순간이었다.)

Manager Kim Jin-myeong from the Planning and Budget Office, standing in the corner, looked down at the documents with a stiff expression. He was confronted with how powerless his logic, talked about cost-effectiveness back in the cubicle, was in the face of field data. (구석에 서 있던 기획예산처 김진명 과장이 굳은 표정으로 서류를 내려다보았다. 큐비클 안에서 가성비를 운운했던 자신의 논리가 현장의 데이터 앞에서 얼마나 무력한지를 직면했다.)

The two silently wrote down numbers on the evaluation sheet. (두 사람은 묵묵히 평가표에 숫자를 써 내려갔다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] “Even After Wartime Operational Control Transition… US Must Establish Northeast Asia Command to Deter North Korea” ([단독] “전작권 전환돼도… 美가 동북아사령부 만들어 지휘해야 北 대응 가능”)
item.description:
[Exclusive] “Even After Wartime Operational Control Transition… US Must Establish Northeast Asia Command to Deter North Korea” ([단독] “전작권 전환돼도… 美가 동북아사령부 만들어 지휘해야 北 대응 가능”)

In a report released on the 18th (local time), the US think tank Atlantic Council argued that “given North Korea’s advanced nuclear and missile capabilities and China’s attempts to pressure and attack the entire first island chain, the separation (of US Forces Korea and US Forces Japan) is no longer sustainable,” calling for the establishment of a new “US Northeast Asia Command” to integrate and manage US forces in South Korea and Japan. The first island chain refers to a maritime defensive line connecting the Japanese archipelago to Taiwan and the Philippines. (미국 싱크탱크 애틀랜틱카운슬이 지난 18일(현지 시각) 공개한 보고서에서 “북한의 고도화된 핵·미사일 능력과 제1도련선 전체를 압박하고 공격하려는 중국의 시도를 고려할 때 (주한미군과 주일미군의) 분리는 더 이상 지속 가능하지 않다”며 ‘미 동북아사령부’를 신설해 주한·주일미군을 통합 관리해야 한다고 주장했다. 제1도련선은 일본 열도에서 대만과 필리핀을 연결하는 해양 방어선이다.)

The authors further stated that even after wartime operational control (OPCON) is transferred to South Korean forces, and despite South Korean commanders of the future combined command coordinating defense operations, the stationing of US Forces Korea and support from US Forces Japan should be conducted “under the broader authority of the Northeast Asia Command.” This report included Colonel Christopher Lee, a Foreign Area Officer (FAO) for the Indo-Pacific region assigned to US Forces Korea, as a co-author. (저자들은 또 한국군으로 전시작전통제권(전작권)이 이양된 후, 한국 방어 작전은 미래연합사의 한국군 사령관이 조율하더라도, 이를 뒷받침하는 주한미군 주둔과 주일미군의 지원은 “동북아사령부의 더 넓은 권한(authority) 하”에서 이뤄져야 한다고 했다. 이번 보고서에는 주한미군 소속의 인도·태평양 담당 해외지역장교(FOA)인 크리스토퍼 리 대령이 공동 저자로 참여했다.)

In the report, they discussed the possibility that provocations by North Korea or a Chinese attack on Taiwan could lead to a “simultaneous crisis” on both fronts, stating that “the security of Japan and South Korea is inseparably linked, and the security of both countries is directly connected to the stability of the entire first island chain, including Taiwan.” Therefore, they argued that the current system, where the US Pacific Command communicates separately with US Forces Japan and US Forces Korea through independent channels, is inefficient. They suggested that “establishing a Northeast Asia Command under the Pacific Command, with responsibility over Japan, South Korea, and surrounding areas, could reduce structural inefficiencies,” as the Pacific Command currently oversees more than 30 countries and regions. (이들은 보고서에서 북한의 도발이나 중국의 대만 공격 등이 양 전선의 ‘동시 위기’로 이어질 가능성을 거론하며 “일본과 한국의 안보는 불가분하게 연결돼 있으며, 양국 안보는 대만을 포함한 제1도련선 전체의 안정과도 직결돼 있다”고 했다. 따라서 미국 태평양사령부가 주일미군, 주한미군과 각기 별도의 채널로만 소통하는 현재의 체제가 효율적이지 않다는 것이다. 이들은 30여 국 이상의 지역을 관할하는 태평양사령부 산하에 “일본, 한국 및 주변 지역을 책임 구역으로 하는 동북아사령부를 창설하면 구조적 비효율성을 줄일 수 있다”고 했다.)

They claimed that a Northeast Asia Command would ensure that even after the OPCON transition, “the US military command chain can exercise authority over US forces in South Korea and Japan, guaranteeing their ability to operate across the borders of host nations.” This implies that it could serve as a mechanism for the US to lead operations in Northeast Asia after OPCON transition. At the “ROK-US Combined Policy Forum” hosted by the Combined Forces Command last December, there was also a proposal to establish a US “Northeast Asia Combat Command” in Seoul. However, US Forces Korea stated, “We are aware of the report, but it reflects the views of the authors and does not represent the official position of the United Nations Command, the Combined Forces Command, or US Forces Korea.” (이들은 동북아사령부가 있으면 한미 전작권 전환 후에도 “미군 지휘 계통이 한국과 일본에 있는 미군에 대한 권한을 행사할 수 있으며, 이들이 주둔국의 경계를 넘어 작전할 수 있도록 보장할 수 있다”고 했다. 전작권 전환 후 미군이 동북아 작전을 주도할 장치가 될 수 있다는 뜻이다. 작년 12월 연합사 주최로 열린 ‘한미 연합정책포럼’에서도 서울에 미군의 ‘동북아 전투사령부’를 창설해야 한다는 주장이 나왔다. 다만 주한미군 측은 “해당 보고서를 인지하고 있다”면서도 “이는 저자들의 견해를 반영한 것이며 유엔사, 연합사 또는 주한미군의 공식 입장을 대변하지 않는다”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil on US Visit: “Over 70 Years of Korea-US Alliance, Like Properly Aged Kimchi” (訪美 송영길 “70년 넘은 한미동맹, 제대로 숙성된 김치 같은 것”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil on US Visit: “Over 70 Years of Korea-US Alliance, Like Properly Aged Kimchi” (訪美 송영길 “70년 넘은 한미동맹, 제대로 숙성된 김치 같은 것”)

Song Young-gil, former leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who is visiting the United States as a special envoy of National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, said on the 24th, “Kimchi takes a long time to ferment, and the more properly it ages, the deeper its flavor becomes,” adding, “The Korea-US alliance, which has endured for over 70 years, is the same. We have all matured and formed a deep bond that goes beyond simple cooperation.” During a speech at the ‘Korean Culture Day’ event hosted by the Korean American Immigration History Museum (Director Kim Min-sun) at the Library of Congress that afternoon, the former leader stated, “There may be slight differences in perspective, but the consensus on the Korea-US alliance, a powerful entity we must protect, cannot be questioned.” <<> With Representative Jeong Cheong-rae stepping down from his leadership position on the 24th and formally announcing his bid for party leadership, it is known that former leader Song will also officially announce his candidacy shortly after returning to Korea. On this day, Representative Song met with House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, as well as Korean-American Democratic Senator Andy Kim and Republican Representative Young Kim. He noted that while President Yoon Suk Yeol and President Donald Trump maintain a very good relationship, there is significant political strife in Korea, and “there may be differing evaluations of the alliance and different perspectives on current issues,” yet he added, “Regardless of which party we belong to, the Korea-US alliance is a pillar protecting the lives of our people, and there is a unanimous consensus that we pursue the same values.” <<> Representative Song also attended a press conference on a Korea-US alliance resolution hosted by pro-Korean Congressman Tom Suozzi in the Capitol that afternoon, alongside People Power Party Representative Cho Kyung-tae. He expressed pride that “Korea and the US have grown together pursuing the same values, such as the rule of law, free market system, fundamental rights, and the judicial system.” He also expressed gratitude regarding the December 3 martial law incident under former President Yoon Suk Yeol, saying, “All members of the National Assembly cooperated almost with one mind against the ‘dictatorial regime’ that neutralized the constitution,” and noted, “The lawmaker who led the charge from the opposition at that time was my colleague, Representative Cho Kyung-tae.” On the 25th, Representative Song is scheduled to attend an event related to the so-called ‘Korean Peninsula Peace Act’ hosted by the Korean American Participation Forum (KAPAC). <<> In April, just before the June National Assembly by-election, Representative Song visited Washington DC and met with Tulsi Gabbard, Director of National Intelligence and former head of intelligence under the Trump administration, among others. Gabbard, a former Democratic congresswoman who supported Trump in the 2024 presidential election, published a book titled ‘For Love of Country’ that sharply criticizes ‘woke’ culture. Representative Song, who was impressed by the book, personally translated it and published it while he was detained at Seoul Detention Center. At the time, he had left the Democratic Party and was affiliated with the ‘Pine Tree Party,’ and contrary to the original title, the Korean edition was titled ‘Leaving the Democratic Party.’ (조정식 국회의장 특사 자격으로 미국을 방문 중인 송영길 전 더불어민주당 대표는 24일 “김치는 숙성에 오랜 시간이 걸리고 제대로 숙성될수록 깊은 풍미를 띠게 된다”며 “70년 넘는 기간 지속된 한미동맹도 이와 같다. 우리 모두는 성숙해졌고, 단순한 협력 이상의 깊은 유대감을 형성하고 있다”고 했다. 송 전 대표는 이날 오후 미주한인이민사박물관(관장 김민선)이 의회 도서관에서 주최한 ‘한국 문화의 날’ 행사 연설에서 “관점에 약간의 차이가 있을 수 있지만 우리가 지켜야 할 강력한 존재인 한미동맹에 대한 합의가 의심받을 수는 없다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

item.title: "Republicans and Democrats Clash, but US-ROK Relations Will Not Be Used as a Political Tool" (“공화·민주 다투지만 한미 관계는 정치적 도구로 삼지 않을 것”)
item.description:
"Republicans and Democrats Clash, but US-ROK Relations Will Not Be Used as a Political Tool" (“공화·민주 다투지만 한미 관계는 정치적 도구로 삼지 않을 것”)

Tom Suozzi, a Democratic congressman and one of the most prominent pro-South Korea figures in the U.S. Congress, held a press conference in front of the Capitol in Washington, D.C. on the 24th, stating, "There is plenty in the world to be discouraged about—war, economic issues, division—but if you want hope for the future, look at the journey the United States and South Korea have taken together over the past 76 years." He emphasized that while political strife between the Republican and Democratic parties is real, the two sides are always "one" when it comes to bilateral issues concerning U.S.-ROK relations. Suozzi, along with Korean-American Republican Congressman Young Kim and Democratic Congresswoman Grace Meng, who has a Korean-American spouse, introduced a resolution (H.Res. 64) in January of last year reaffirming the importance of the U.S.-ROK alliance. (미 의회의 대표적인 지한파(知韓派) 인사인 톰 수오지 민주당 하원의원은 24일 워싱턴 DC의 의회 의사당 앞에서 기자회견을 열어 “전쟁, 경제 문제, 분열 등 세상에 낙담할 일이 많지만 미래에 대한 희망을 갖고 싶다면 지난 76년 동안 미국과 한국이 함께 걸어온 여정을 살펴보라”며 공화당과 민주당 간 정쟁이 있는 것은 사실이지만 한미 관계에 관한 양자(兩者) 현안에 있어서는 언제나 ‘하나’라는 점을 강조했다. 수오지는 한국계 영 김 공화당 하원의원, 한국계를 배우자로 둔 그레이스 맹 민주당 의원과 지난해 1월 한미동맹에 대한 중요성을 재확인하는 결의안(H.Res. 64)을 발의했다.)

Suozzi, a four-term congressman representing New York, said, "Think about the transformation and incredible success of a country devastated by war in 1950. A nation that was in despair has now become one of the world's leading powers in the economy, democracy, human rights, and the rule of law—it's truly remarkable." He added, "Currently, the world is witnessing a struggle between countries that share the same values as the U.S. and South Korea—believing in free markets, opposing government intervention and corporate subsidies, and upholding the rule of law—and authoritarian states that do not. To get more people to embrace the values we share, we need to build more friendships." (뉴욕주(州)를 지역구로 하는 4선(選) 의원인 수오지는 “1950년 전쟁으로 황폐해진 나라에서 일어난 변화와 놀라운 성공을 생각해 보라”며 “절망에 빠졌던 나라가 이제는 경제, 민주주의, 인권, 법치 분야에서 세계를 이끄는 리더 중 하나로 거듭난 모습이 정말 놀랍다”고 했다. 이어 “현재 세계에선 한미같이 같은 가치를 가진 나라들과 자유 시장을 믿지 않고, 정부의 개입과 기업에 대한 보조금을 지지하며, 법치주의를 중요하게 생각하지 않는 권위주의 국가들과의 다툼이 진행되고 있다”며 더 많은 사람이 한미가 공유하는 가치를 받아들일 수 있게 만들기 위해 “우정을 더 많이 쌓아야 한다”고 했다.)

The resolution, which highlights the importance of the U.S.-ROK alliance, the sacrifices of Korean War veterans, and the continued strengthening of strategic cooperation between the two nations, passed the House Foreign Affairs Committee with a vote of 43 to 3 on May 13 and is now awaiting a full floor vote. When asked about the prospects and timing of the resolution's passage, Suozzi told our newspaper, "This resolution only needs to be scheduled for a full House vote. It has bipartisan support and will definitely pass. There's so much going on in Congress these days; it's just a matter of when it can be addressed." House Foreign Affairs Committee Ranking Democrat Gregory Meeks said, "Democrats and Republicans may have differences in political views, but we do not use South Korea as a political tool. Our relationship with a friend (South Korea) cannot be a political issue." (한미동맹의 중요성, 6·25 전쟁 참전용사들의 희생, 한미 전략적 협력의 지속적 강화 등을 담고 있는 결의안은 지난 5월 13일 하원 외교위원회에서 43대3으로 통과돼 본회의 표결을 앞둔 상태다. 수오지는 결의안 통과 전망과 시점을 묻는 본지 질의에 “이 결의안은 본회의 상정만 남았다”며 “양당의 지지를 받고 있어 확실히 통과할 것이다. 요즘 의회에서 다른 일들이 너무 많이 진행되고 있는데, 단지 언제 처리할 수 있을지 일정의 문제”라고 했다. 하원 외교위 민주당 간사인 그레고리 믹스 의원은 “민주당과 공화당이 정치적 견해 차이가 있을 수 있지만 우리는 한국을 정치적 도구로 삼지 않는다”며 “친구(한국)와의 관계는 정치적 쟁점이 될 수 없다”고 했다.)

Before the press conference, at the "Korean Culture Day" event organized by the Korean American Immigration History Museum (directed by Kim Min-sun) at the Library of Congress, Congresswoman Young Kim, who introduced the resolution, took the stage alongside Suozzi. Kim, who chairs the Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on Asia and the Pacific, said, "When you watch the news, it's all about promoting division, but regardless of party affiliation, lawmakers are always striving to find common ground. This resolution is an example of that." Kim, who is running for a fourth term in the November midterm elections, added, "I came as an immigrant and became a proud American. America embraces diversity, allowing us to maintain our own cultures and traditions. Please don’t forget that I am the only Korean-American in the Republican Party." (이날 기자회견에 앞서 의회 도서관에서 미주한인이민사박물관(관장 김민선)이 주최한 ‘한국 문화의 날’ 행사에선 결의안을 발의안 영 김 의원이 수오지와 함께 무대에 올랐다. 외교위 동아시아·태평양 소위원장인 김 의원은 “뉴스를 보면 온통 분열을 조장하는 내용으로 가득하지만, 의원들은 서로 정당이 달라도 항상 공통점을 찾기 위해 노력하고 있다”며 “결의안이 그 모범 사례”라고 했다. 11월 중간 선거에서 4선에 도전하는 김 의원은 “이민자로 와서 자랑스러운 미국인이 될 수 있었는데 다양성을 포용하는 미국은 우리 각자의 문화, 전통을 유지할 수 있게 해준다. 내가 공화당의 유일한 한국계라는 사실을 잊지 말아 달라”라고 했다.)

Currently, a bill known as the "Partnership with Korea Act (PWKA)"—which would issue separate visas for skilled Korean professionals—has been introduced in Congress under Congresswoman Young Kim's name. Following last year's incident at the Hyundai Motor and LG Energy Solution plant in Georgia, there has been a legislative campaign inside and outside Congress, and the South Korean Embassy in the U.S. has hired lobbyists, with Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha actively lobbying lawmakers. Suozzi said, "South Korean companies are among the largest foreign investors in the U.S. It's very important to temporarily bring in personnel from South Korea to train our workers and help more people become familiar with the technology in the process. What happened in Georgia must never happen again." Suozzi also emphasized that "both countries should remove barriers and create an open environment for more effective trade." (현재 의회에는 숙련된 한국인 전문직에 한해 별도의 비자를 발급하는 이른바 ‘한국과의 파트너 법안(PWKA)’이 영 김 의원 명의로 발의돼 있다. 지난해 조지아주(州) 현대차·LG에너지솔루션 공장 구금 사태를 계기로 의회 안팎에서 입법 캠페인이 벌어지고 있고, 주미 대사관도 로비스트를 고용해 강경화 대사가 의원들을 상대로 로비 활동을 하고 있다. 수오지는 “한국 기업들은 미국의 최대 외국인 투자자”라며 “일시적이라도 (한국에서) 인력을 데려와 우리 근로자들을 교육하고, 더 많은 사람들이 그 과정에서 (기술에) 익숙해질 수 있도록 하는 것이 매우 중요하다. 조지아에서 발생한 일이 다시는 반복되면 안 된다”고 했다. 수오지는 “양국이 더 효과적인 무역을 위해 장벽을 없애고 개방적인 환경을 조성해야 한다”고도 했다.)

item.title: North Korean Soldier Defects, Crossing Minefields and Barbed Wire (지뢰·철책 뚫고 북한군 1명 귀순)
item.description:
North Korean Soldier Defects, Crossing Minefields and Barbed Wire (지뢰·철책 뚫고 북한군 1명 귀순)

A North Korean soldier defected to the South by crossing the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) along the central front on the 23rd, it was revealed on the 24th. Despite North Korea laying mines and erecting barbed wire fences as part of border fortification efforts since 2024, at least four individuals have defected in the past year alone. (북한군 1명이 23일 중부전선을 통해 군사분계선(MDL)을 월남해 귀순 의사를 밝힌 것으로 24일 나타났다. 북한은 2024년부터 국경선화 작업을 하며 지뢰를 묻고 철책을 세우고 있지만 지난 1년 동안에만 최소 4명이 귀순했다.)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced on the 24th that they secured one North Korean soldier in the Cheorwon-gun area of Gangwon Province on the night of the 23rd. The soldier expressed his intention to defect, and it is known that South Korean forces successfully conducted a defection-inducing operation around 10 p.m. The soldier is male, but his rank and other details have not been disclosed. The JCS stated, "Relevant authorities are investigating the specific details." No unusual movements from North Korea have been reported in connection with this incident so far. (합동참모본부는 23일 야간에 강원도 철원군 일대에서 북한군 1명의 신병을 확보했다고 24일 밝혔다. 해당 군인은 귀순 의사를 밝혔고, 오후 10시쯤 우리 군이 귀순 유도 작전을 성공적으로 진행한 것으로 알려졌다. 해당 군인은 남성으로 계급 등은 알려지지 않았다. 합참은 “관련 세부 사항에 대해서는 관계 기관에서 조사 중”이라고 설명했다. 현재까지 북한군은 이와 관련해 특이 동향은 없는 것으로 전해졌다.)

The area is known to have been fortified by North Korea with landmines and barbed wire fences. A military source explained, "Even when laying mines, they create pathways for movement. If the soldier knew these routes, it would have been possible to pass through the minefield." (해당 지역은 북한이 지뢰를 매설하고 철책을 세운 곳으로 알려졌다. 군 소식통은 “지뢰 매설 작업을 하더라도 이동을 위해 통로를 만들어 놓는데 해당 루트를 알고 있었다면 지뢰지대 통과가 가능했을 것”이라고 했다.)

This marks the fourth known defection case since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration. On July 3 last year, one male civilian crossed the MDL along the central-western front, and on July 31 of the same year, another male civilian defected through the Han River neutral zone. In October last year, a North Korean soldier crossed the MDL along the central front and expressed his intention to defect. This is the first defection of a North Korean soldier in eight months. (이재명 정부 출범 후 알려진 귀순 사례는 이번이 네 번째다. 지난해 7월 3일 남성 주민 1명이 중서부 전선 MDL을 넘어왔고, 같은 달 31일 또 다른 남성 주민 1명이 한강 중립 수역을 통해 귀순했다. 지난해 10월에는 북한군 1명이 중부전선 MDL을 넘어와 귀순 의사를 밝혔다. 북한 군인의 귀순은 8개월 만이다.)

Meanwhile, the United Nations Command (UNC), which determines violations of the Armistice Agreement, posted an article on the 24th titled "UNC Fact Sheet: DMZ Armistice Agreement Implementation and Recent North Korean Activities," stating that North Korea's installation of barbed wire fences and landmine laying north of the MDL "does not constitute a violation of the Armistice Agreement." (한편 정전협정 위반 여부를 판단하는 유엔군사령부는 24일 ‘유엔사 팩트시트: DMZ 정전협정 이행 및 최근 북한의 활동’이라는 게시물을 올리고 북한이 MDL 이북에서 철책 설치와 지뢰 매설을 하는 것은 “정전협정 위반이 아니다”라고 밝혔다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said last December, "North Korea, worried that the South might invade the North, is building triple-layered barbed wire fences along the MDL, erecting barriers to prevent tanks from crossing, and cutting off bridges and roads." This suggests that the fence installations are defensive in nature. In contrast, the Ministry of National Defense stated on the 22nd and 23rd that North Korea's activities near the MDL are violations of the Armistice Agreement. A ministry official said, "This is the first time we have stated this publicly, but the government has been viewing these actions as violations of the Armistice Agreement for some time." (이재명 대통령은 지난해 12월 “북한은 혹시 남쪽이 북침하지 않을까 걱정해서 (군사분계선에) 3중 철책을 치고 탱크라도 넘어올까 방벽을 쌓고 다리와 도로를 끊고 있다”고 했다. 철책 설치 등이 방어적 성격이란 취지다. 반면 국방부는 지난 22일과 23일 잇달아 북한의 MDL 일대 활동이 ‘정전협정 위반’이라는 입장을 밝혔다. 국방부 관계자는 “대외적으로 밝힌 것은 처음이지만 정부 차원에서는 이전부터 정전협정 위반으로 보고 있었던 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Swiftly Decided 'Honam Investment'... Semiconductor Industry Caught in Political Turmoil (속전속결 ‘호남 투자’… 정치에 휘둘리는 반도체)
item.description:
Swiftly Decided 'Honam Investment'... Semiconductor Industry Caught in Political Turmoil (속전속결 ‘호남 투자’… 정치에 휘둘리는 반도체)

The presidential office has officially confirmed Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's unprecedented-scale investment of over 400 trillion won in Honam's semiconductor sector. Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy office, stated at a Kwanhun Club forum held at the Seoul Press Center on the 24th that "(related) discussions are in the final stages." Semiconductor factory investments, involving astronomical sums, typically take at least seven years just for review, and this process is conducted in strict secrecy. However, this investment appeared to involve the presidential office and the ruling party actively participating in the decision-making by issuing various demands regarding timing, scale, and regional selection. The opposition criticized this as the political exploitation of a key national strategic industry. Park Seong-hoon, senior spokesperson for the People Power Party, said, "The Lee Jae-myung administration is essentially guiding or pressuring corporate investment directions under the guise of balanced regional development," calling it "the worst example of government-led economic control." Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reformist Party, argued, "The administration is twisting arms to send Samsung and SK Hynix to Honam." (400조원 이상으로 추산되는 삼성전자·SK하이닉스의 사상 최대 규모 호남 반도체 투자를 청와대가 공식화했다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 24일 서울 프레스센터에서 열린 관훈토론회에서 “(관련) 논의가 마무리 단계”라고 밝혔다. 반도체 공장 투자는 천문학적 자금이 투입되기 때문에 보통 검토에만 7년 이상이 소요되고, 이 과정은 철저히 비밀리에 추진된다. 그런데 이번 투자는 청와대와 여권이 시기, 규모, 지역 선정에 각종 주문을 쏟아내며 결정에 관여하는 모양새였다. 야당은 국가 핵심 전략 산업을 정치적으로 이용하고 있다고 비판했다. 국민의힘 박성훈 수석 대변인은 “이재명 정권이 지방 균형 발전이라는 포장지로 기업의 투자 방향을 사실상 유도하거나 압박하고 있다”면서 “최악의 관치 경제”라고 했고, 개혁신당 이준석 대표는 “정권이 팔을 비틀어서 삼성과 하이닉스를 호남으로 보낸다”고 주장했다.)

The presidential office is set to hold a public-private joint meeting on the "Great Spatial Transformation of National Territory" on the 29th, with both companies expected to announce investment details soon. President Lee Jae-myung met with SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won on the 19th to finalize related discussions, and is scheduled to meet Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong on the 25th. During this process, companies that had initially considered building a packaging plant for back-end processes are reportedly adjusting plans to include new fabs (front-end processes) for cutting-edge circuit patterning, in response to political demands. (청와대는 29일 ‘국토 공간 대전환’ 민관 합동 회의를 여는데, 이를 계기로 두 기업은 조만간 투자 내용을 발표할 예정이다. 이재명 대통령은 지난 19일 최태원 SK그룹 회장을 만나 관련 논의를 마쳤고, 25일에는 이재용 삼성전자 회장을 만난다. 이 과정에서 당초 반도체 후공정인 패키징 공장 정도를 고려했던 기업들은 정치권의 요구에 따라 결국 최첨단 회로를 그리는 팹(전 공정)까지 신설하는 방안을 조율하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

The presidential office emphasized that it is not relocating the planned Yongin factory to Honam. Director Kim stated, "We are by no means moving the factory being built in the capital area. If we wait until Yongin is fully occupied to say 'let's start elsewhere,' it will already be too late." This implies that since the Yongin semiconductor cluster is expected to reach saturation around 2035, a separate new factory in a provincial area is necessary. He added, "There's no way companies would make such enormous investments just because the government pursues balanced regional development," denying that the investment is being forced by the government. Ahn Ki-hyun, executive director of the Korea Semiconductor Industry Association, noted, "It's true that due to water shortages in the capital area, we need to look outside it, but normally, site selection alone takes over seven years for a semiconductor plant. That process is conducted in strict secrecy, considering many factors. The current atmosphere is clearly abnormal." (청와대는 기존에 추진 중인 용인 공장을 호남으로 옮기는 것은 아니라고 강조했다. 김 실장은 “수도권에 짓고 있는 공장을 옮기는 것이 결코 아니다”라며 “용인이 다 차는 것을 보고 나서야 ‘다른 데 시작하자’고 하면 그때는 이미 늦는다”고 했다. 용인 반도체 클러스터가 2035년경 포화 상태에 이르니, 지방에 별도의 새 공장을 지어야 한다는 얘기다. 또 “정부가 지방 균형 발전을 추구한다고 해서 기업들이 이런 어마어마한 투자를 쉽게 결정할 리 없다”고 했다. 정부가 강요한 투자가 아니라는 것이다. 안기현 반도체산업협회 전무는 “수도권의 물 부족 등으로 비수도권을 찾아야 하는 상황은 맞다”면서도 “반도체 공장을 짓는 데 통상 부지 검토만 7년 이상이 소요된다. 그 과정은 철저히 비밀리에 수행되고, 여러 요소를 고려해야 한다. 지금의 분위기는 분명히 비정상적”이라고 했다.)

◇ Semiconductor announcement timed for July launch of South Jeollanam-Gwangju City... Gwangju military airfield site likely (◇7월 전남광주시 출범 맞춰 반도체 발표… 광주 軍공항 부지 유력)

The Honam semiconductor cluster began to take shape in earnest after President Lee's remarks at the "K-Semiconductor Vision and Growth Strategy Report Meeting" on December 10 last year, when he said, "Turn your attention to the southern region with abundant renewable energy and take an interest in building a new industrial ecosystem there." Discussions then intensified in conjunction with political issues like the integration of Gwangju and South Jeolla, and Daejeon and South Chungcheong. As local elections approached, Honam candidates from the Democratic Party rushed to make promises to attract semiconductor investments. The Democratic Party even went so far as to use slogans like "Moving semiconductors to Honam ends the insurrection." In response to backlash from the capital area, including Yongin, the presidential office calmed things down by stating, "We are not currently considering relocating companies from the cluster." (호남 반도체 클러스터는 이 대통령이 작년 12월 10일 ‘K반도체 비전과 육성 전략 보고회’에서 “재생에너지가 풍부한 남쪽 지방으로 눈길을 돌려서 그 지역에서 새로운 산업 생태계를 구축하는 데 관심을 가져달라”고 하면서 본격적으로 추진되기 시작했다. 이후 광주·전남 통합, 대전·충남 통합 같은 정치 이슈와 맞물려 논의가 증폭됐다. 지방선거가 다가오자 민주당 호남 후보들은 앞다퉈 반도체 투자 유치 공약을 내세웠다. 민주당에서 “반도체 호남 이전이 내란 종식”이라는 구호까지 나올 정도였다. 이에 대해 용인 등 수도권에서 반발이 일어나자 청와대는 “클러스터 대상 기업 이전을 검토하지는 않은 상황”이라고 진화했다.)

However, immediately after the June local elections, discussions about semiconductor investment in Honam reignited, mainly among the ruling party. News emerged that discussions at the presidential office had rapidly progressed, and that President Lee would meet Chey Tae-won and Lee Jae-yong in succession. In Honam political circles, there were even remarks like, "The timing will be aligned with the launch of the integrated Gwangju-South Jeolla special city on July 1st," and "It's a card to win over Honam voters ahead of the August party convention." This suggests the announcement of the Honam semiconductor investment is not unrelated to the political calendar. This is why the opposition criticizes the investment as "the administration pandering to Honam." (그러나 6월 지방선거 직후 여권을 중심으로 반도체 호남 투자론이 다시 불붙기 시작했다. 청와대에서 논의가 급진전됐다는 이야기가 나오고 이 대통령이 최태원, 이재용 회장을 잇달아 만난다는 사실이 공개됐다. 호남 정치권에선 “7월 1일로 예정된 광주·전남 통합 특별시 출범에 타이밍을 맞출 것” “8월 전당대회를 앞두고 호남 민심을 얻을 수 있는 카드”란 말까지 나왔다. 호남 반도체 투자 발표가 정치 일정과 무관치 않다는 것이다. 야당이 이번 투자에 대해 “정권의 호남 챙기기”라고 비판하는 이유가 여기에 있다.)

An official familiar with the matter said, "While I fully empathize with the goal of balanced regional development, the atmosphere is that even if we propose other infrastructure investments to the government, it has to be semiconductors, and if we hope for another region, it has to be Honam." (이번 사안을 잘 아는 한 관계자는 “지역 균형 발전이라는 목적에는 충분히 공감하지만 (정부에) 다른 인프라 투자를 제안해도 무조건 반도체, 다른 지역을 희망해도 무조건 호남으로 가야 하는 분위기”라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, some analysts suggest that the surge in AI-driven memory demand is changing the calculation for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix regarding semiconductor factory expansion. Samsung Electronics is reportedly planning to shorten the construction period for its Pyeongtaek plant, currently under construction, and its Yongin fab (6th phase), which is in the land acquisition stage. This means the "post-Yongin" period for building next-generation semiconductor lines may come sooner than originally expected. SK Hynix, with smaller production capacity compared to Samsung, is in greater need of additional fab construction. (한편에서는 AI발 메모리 수요가 폭발하면서 반도체 공장 증설에 대한 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 셈법이 달라지고 있다는 분석도 나온다. 삼성전자는 현재 건설 중인 평택과 토지 수용 단계인 용인 팹(6기) 공사 기간을 최대한 단축한다는 방침으로 알려졌다. 차세대 반도체 라인을 지을 ‘포스트 용인’이 필요한 시점도 당초보다 앞당겨지는 셈이다. 삼성전자에 비해 생산 능력이 작은 SK하이닉스는 추가 팹 건설이 더 절실하다.)

That Yongin faces limitations for further expansion due to its location is a point of agreement between the government and the semiconductor industry. The problem is the lack of suitable large-scale sites to replace Yongin. This requires at least 3.3 million square meters of flat land, ultra-high voltage power, hundreds of thousands of tons of ultrapure water daily, and a talent pool ranging from construction workers to technicians and master's/doctoral-level experts, along with a semiconductor partner ecosystem. Water supply issues are somewhat easing as recycling improves the reuse rate of semiconductor process water. (용인이 입지상 한계로 추가 확장이 어렵다는 점은 정부와 반도체 업계가 공감하는 대목이다. 문제는 용인을 이을 대규모 입지가 마땅찮다는 점이다. 최소 100만평 이상의 평지, 초고압 전력, 하루 수십만t의 초순수(超純水), 그리고 건설 인력부터 기술자, 석·박사급 인재까지 아우르는 인력 풀과 반도체 협력 생태계가 모두 갖춰져야 하기 때문이다. 그나마 용수는 리사이클을 통해 반도체 용수 재이용률을 끌어올리게 되면서 과거에 비해 어려움이 줄고 있다.)

The biggest challenge is securing engineers. North Chungcheong Province, home to over 300 semiconductor companies including SK Hynix and DB HiTek, suffers from severe labor shortages even though it is adjacent to the capital area. Many companies fail to properly secure personnel across the board, from low-skilled operators to equipment maintenance staff, engineers, R&D personnel, and office workers. One back-end semiconductor company posts job openings year-round for all positions. A fabless (semiconductor design) company, struggling to recruit master's and doctoral talent, recently hired workers from Southeast Asia. An industry insider commented, "There's already widespread dissatisfaction about the distance to Icheon and Pyeongtaek, which is currently seen as the southern limit. In Honam, the workforce issue could become an even bigger challenge." (최대 관건은 엔지니어 확보다. SK하이닉스·DB하이텍 등 300여 반도체 기업이 있는 충북은 수도권과 접해 있는데도 인력난이 극심하다. 많은 기업이 저숙련 오퍼레이터부터 장비 유지·보수 인력, 엔지니어, R&D 인력, 사무직까지 제대로 확보하지 못하고 있다. 한 반도체 후공정 기업은 직종을 가리지 않고 1년 내내 상시 채용 공고를 내는 처지다. 팹리스(반도체 설계) 기업은 석·박사 인력 채용이 어려워 최근 동남아 출신 인력을 채용했다. 반도체 업계 관계자는 “현재 남방한계선으로 통하는 이천·평택조차 지리적으로 멀다는 불만이 팽배한데 호남에서는 인력 문제가 훨씬 큰 과제가 될 가능성이 높다”고 했다.)

Especially for HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) manufacturing, development and production processes are closely linked, requiring developers to be deployed en masse to production sites. With thousands of personnel needing to live near the semiconductor fab for at least several years, living conditions are paramount. The industry's assessment is that no region in South Korea currently meets all these conditions. This explains why there are talks of needing at least a 10-year timeline for long-term infrastructure development. (특히 HBM(고대역폭 메모리) 제조는 개발과 생산 공정이 밀접하게 연계돼 있어 개발자들이 대규모로 생산 현장에 투입돼야 한다. 수천 명 인력이 최소 수년 동안 반도체 팹 인근에서 생활해야 하는 만큼 정주 여건이 무엇보다 중요하다. 당장 이 모든 조건을 충족하는 지역은 현재 국내에 없다는 게 업계의 진단이다. 최소 10년 단위의 장기 인프라 구축 기간이 필요하다는 얘기가 나오는 이유다.)

Paradoxically, this "10-year time gap" is seen as the link that enabled a compromise between the government and the semiconductor industry. The government would abandon its initial plan to "disperse the Yongin semiconductor cluster" and instead provide a site and infrastructure to serve as a "post-Yongin" option, while semiconductor companies resolve their difficult next-site selection dilemma. (역설적으로 이 ‘10년의 시차’가 정부와 반도체 업계의 이해 절충을 가능하게 한 고리가 된 것으로 풀이된다. 정부는 당초의 ‘용인 반도체 분산론’을 접고 ‘포스트 용인’ 역할을 할 부지와 인프라를 제공하고, 반도체 기업들은 당장 풀기 어려운 차기 입지 고민을 해소한다는 것이다.)

The former site of the Gwangju military airfield, which would be vacated after the air force base relocates to Muan, etc., is considered a strong candidate location. The key question is whether the challenges, such as infrastructure development that takes at least 10 years, can be carried out steadily under the reality of regime changes every five years. Another variable is that, given the volatility of the semiconductor cycle, a hastily prepared large-scale investment plan could falter when the industry enters a downturn. (군 공항이 무안 등으로 이전하고 남는 광주 군공항 종전 부지가 유력한 입지로 거론된다. 관건은 최소 10년이 걸리는 인프라 조성 등의 과제를 5년 단위로 정권이 바뀌는 현실에서 흔들림 없이 해낼 수 있느냐는 것이다. 반도체 사이클의 변동성을 감안할 때 급조된 대규모 투자 계획이 향후 다운사이클(경기 하강기) 진입 시 흔들릴 수 있다는 점도 변수다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Cyberattacks on National Election Commission Already Exceed 100,000 This Year… N. Korea's Attempts Surge 68-Fold ([단독] 선관위 해킹 공격 올해 벌써 10만건… 北 시도 68배 늘어)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Cyberattacks on National Election Commission Already Exceed 100,000 This Year… N. Korea's Attempts Surge 68-Fold ([단독] 선관위 해킹 공격 올해 벌써 10만건… 北 시도 68배 늘어)

The number of cyberattacks on the National Election Commission (NEC) has already surpassed 100,000 in the first half of this year alone, marking an all-time high. North Korea's cyberattacks have skyrocketed 68-fold from 52 cases last year to 3,543 cases in the first half of this year. (중앙선거관리위원회에 대한 사이버 공격 건수가 올해 상반기에만 벌써 10만건을 돌파한 것으로 나타났다. 역대 최대 수치다. 북한의 사이버 공격은 지난해 52건에서 올해 상반기 3543건으로 68배 폭증했다.)

According to the "Status of Cyberattacks on the NEC" obtained by the office of Rep. Shin Dong-wook of the People Power Party on the 24th, attempts to attack the NEC's website, servers, and systems totaled 101,179 from January to the 18th of this month. The NEC explains that cyberattacks typically increase during election years. However, compared to 39,896 attacks in 2022, when the 20th presidential election and the 8th local elections were held consecutively, and 47,140 attacks last year, which included the 21st presidential election, this year's figure has increased significantly. <<> By Internet Protocol (IP) addresses involved in the cyberattacks, the countries with the highest numbers were the United States (17,884 cases), Vietnam (6,084 cases), India (5,719 cases), North Korea (3,543 cases), Turkey (3,303 cases), and the Philippines (2,668 cases). Last year, the top countries were the United States (15,514 cases), China (4,414 cases), India (3,164 cases), and domestic (1,998 cases). It is suggested that hackers may have changed the bypass IPs used for cyberattacks, causing a decrease in China and an increase in Vietnam and others. <<> Regarding the surge in attacks this year, the NEC said, "Hackers are increasingly using AI automation tools, which has led to a sharp rise in the number of attempts." It added, "While there were many attempts, they did not result in actual hacking that damaged the election system." <<> However, with about 40 days left until the last presidential election on April 23, the NEC's election statistics system on its website was targeted by a cyberattack. Additionally, a joint security inspection by the National Intelligence Service and others in 2023 revealed North Korean cyberattack incidents and vulnerabilities in the NEC's voting and counting systems and internal networks. <<> Rep. Shin Dong-wook, a member of the National Assembly's special committee for the NEC's parliamentary investigation, said, "This is a stark example of why public trust in the NEC is low." He added, "Through this parliamentary investigation into the deprivation of suffrage rights, we will thoroughly clarify responsibility and ensure that measures to address cyberattacks and responses are included in the reform plans for the NEC." (24일 국민의힘 신동욱 의원실이 확보한 ‘중앙선관위 사이버 공격 현황’에 따르면 선관위 홈페이지나 서버, 시스템 등에 대한 사이버 공격 시도 건수는 올해 1월부터 이달 18일까지 총 10만1179건에 달했다. 보통 선거가 있는 해에 사이버 공격 건수가 증가한다는 게 선관위 설명이다. 하지만 20대 대선, 제8회 지방선거가 잇따라 실시된 2022년의 3만9896건, 21대 대선이 있었던 지난해 4만7140건과 비교해서도 올해는 눈에 띄게 늘었다.)

item.title: Former pro-Yoon supporters without a focal point… Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon are 'building their own camps' (구심점 없는 옛 친윤… 오세훈·한동훈 ‘내편 만들기’)
item.description:
Former pro-Yoon supporters without a focal point… Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon are 'building their own camps' (구심점 없는 옛 친윤… 오세훈·한동훈 ‘내편 만들기’)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (Busan North Gap) are expanding their outreach to former pro-Yoon lawmakers within the People Power Party (PPP). The former pro-Yoon faction, which forms the mainstream of the PPP, has been left without a clear leadership focal point since the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Some in political circles interpret this as "the start of a full-fledged competition for leadership within the conservative camp ahead of the 2028 general election." <<>> Mayor Oh attended a lecture invitation from the 'Future Innovation Forum', a parliamentary research group, on the 24th. The Future Innovation Forum is a group initiated by senior former pro-Yoon lawmakers of the PPP. During his lecture on the theme 'Restoring conservative values and the future', Mayor Oh stated, "While it may seem satisfying when someone fights hard in ordinary times, the one who actually wins the election at the decisive moment is the true filial son." This was interpreted as a critique of PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who appeals only to hardcore supporters. <<>> Regarding Jang’s position as party leader, Mayor Oh said, "A collective consensus among lawmakers is gradually forming from the grassroots," adding, "The time has come for senior lawmakers to play a significant role in a weighty manner." The lecture was attended by 28 PPP lawmakers, including floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik and lawmakers Kim Ki-hyun, Kim Seok-ki, Kim Jeong-jae, Yoon Han-hong, and Park Soo-young. A significant number of the attending lawmakers were from the former pro-Yoon faction. <<>> Mayor Oh is being assessed as expanding his sphere of activity into 'Yeouido political circles' following the local elections. He has scheduled dinner meetings with PPP lawmakers from the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee and Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee until the end of this month, and plans to meet with floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik next month. He also plans to meet with Seoul-area lawmakers who supported his mayoral election bid. A PPP lawmaker said, "Mayor Oh was relatively perceived as lacking in personal connections with lawmakers, but he appears to be aiming to secure allies within the party, including the pro-Yoon faction, with an eye on the 2030 presidential election." <<>> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is also extensively contacting PPP lawmakers, including those from the former pro-Yoon faction. The bill to amend the Board of Audit and Inspection Act, which Han first proposed after being elected as a lawmaker, was co-signed by 31 lawmakers, including former pro-Yoon figures such as Yoon Sang-hyun, Yoon Jae-ok, Park Dae-chul, Kim Dae-sik, and Seo Cheon-ho. Han had previously joined the 'Future Innovation Forum' at the suggestion of lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun’s side. <<>> During his tenure as PPP party leader, Han faced fierce criticism from the pro-Yoon faction due to his conflict with then-President Yoon. After the impeachment motion against former President Yoon passed in the National Assembly, the pro-Yoon faction demanded his resignation as party leader and tacitly allowed party leader Jang Dong-hyuk to expel Han over the 'party member bulletin board' issue. Among the former pro-Yoon faction, there is considerable negative sentiment regarding Han’s reinstatement into the party. <<>> However, a senior lawmaker from the Yeongnam region reported, "Since Han was elected in the by-election, voices within the pro-Yoon faction are emerging that 'we must fight the next general election alongside Han.'" Han reportedly held a private meeting on the 21st with PPP lawmakers from Busan districts, including Kim Do-eup, Lee Seong-kwon, Kim Dae-sik, Kwak Kyu-taek, and Jeong Seong-guk. On the 23rd, he also attended a forum on 'Electoral System Reform' hosted by PPP lawmaker Lee Seong-kwon (Busan Saha Gap). Han’s side has stated, "If they are willing to join the conservative reconstruction, we will work with anyone regardless of past factional ties." <<>> Among the 110 PPP lawmakers, the mainstream—including the former pro-Yoon faction—is estimated to number around 60. They lost their focal point after former President Yoon was impeached. While they were known to have supported party leader Jang Dong-hyuk during last year’s party convention, many assessed that they failed to form a unified front. However, following the recent local elections, the former pro-Yoon faction appears to be turning its attention to Mayor Oh and lawmaker Han. An opposition figure commented, "With nomination for the general election at stake depending on who seizes leadership of the conservative camp, the former pro-Yoon faction is also approaching Mayor Oh and Han from a practical standpoint." <<>> There is also a perspective that tensions between Mayor Oh and lawmaker Han have begun in earnest as they seek to co-opt the mainstream of the PPP. Mayor Oh was absent from the 'Electoral System Reform' forum on the 23rd, where both were expected to attend. Conversely, lawmaker Han did not attend the Future Innovation Forum on the same day, where Mayor Oh was the lecturer. item.title: The Crisis-Hit Rebuilding Korea Party: Removing "Cho Kuk" from Its Name (위기의 조국혁신당, 간판서 조국 이름 지우나)
item.description:
The Crisis-Hit Rebuilding Korea Party: Removing "Cho Kuk" from Its Name (위기의 조국혁신당, 간판서 조국 이름 지우나)

The Rebuilding Korea Party, facing its greatest crisis since its founding following former leader Cho Kuk's failed bid to enter the National Assembly, has seen internal calls to change its name. The proposal is to remove "Cho Kuk" from the Rebuilding Korea Party's title. (조국혁신당이 조국 전 대표의 국회 입성 실패로 창당 이후 최대 위기를 맞은 가운데, 당내에서 당명 변경 주장까지 나왔다. 조국혁신당에서 ‘조국’을 빼자는 것이다.)

Floor leader Kim Joon-hyung said in a YTN radio interview on the 23rd that "amending the party name is something worth considering." Kim noted, "During the general election, former leader Cho stirred up a whirlwind and rallied support, aided by the party name," but added, "It's both our strength and our weakness." A source from the ruling party stated, "There have been many criticisms that the inclusion of 'Cho Kuk' in the name, such as being called the 'Cho Kuk Party' instead of the official abbreviation 'Rebuilding Party,' has limited its appeal." However, no formal discussion on the party name has yet taken place. Some members of the Rebuilding Korea Party have reportedly opposed the idea, saying, "How can you talk about the Rebuilding Korea Party without Cho Kuk?" <<> Since Cho's defeat in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, the Rebuilding Korea Party has been continuously criticizing the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party. It demanded the withdrawal of what it called "anti-reform figures" after President Lee appointed a series of former prosecutors to the Blue House shortly after the election, specifically targeting Han Chan-shik, the senior secretary for civil affairs, who oversaw the investigation into the Moon Jae-in government's "blacklist case." Acting party leader Shin Jang-sik, during a party meeting on that day, said regarding the establishment of a prosecution office and a major crimes investigation office under the abolition of the prosecution service, "The government and the ruling party are just pretending to do something they don't want to do. They're sitting idly, like watching someone else's grave-cleaning." The previous day, in a spokesperson's comment, the Rebuilding Korea Party also opposed the appointment of former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Hee-gwan as president of the Korean Red Cross, labeling him a "figure who opposed the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol" and requesting the president reject the confirmation. A Democratic Party official remarked, "This is retaliation, tying us up over every little thing because the Democratic Party didn't yield in the Pyeongtaek-eul election." <<> Amid this, former leader Cho has been actively continuing his social media activities after his defeat. He has already visited the Honam region and posts multiple items on Facebook daily. There are also reactions within the party, such as, "Isn't former leader Cho returning too quickly?" (김준형 원내대표는 23일 오후 YTN라디오 인터뷰에서 “당명 개정도 생각해볼 문제”라고 했다. 김 원내대표는 “총선 때 조 전 대표가 돌풍을 일으키고 뭉칠 수 있었던 데에는 당명의 도움이 있었다”면서도 “우리의 장점이기도 하고 단점이기도 하다”고 했다. 여권 한 관계자는 “정식 약칭인 ‘혁신당’ 대신 ‘조국당’이라고 불리는 등 당명에 ‘조국’이 들어간 것 때문에 확장성이 떨어진다는 지적이 그동안 많았다”고 했다. 다만 아직 당에서 당명과 관련한 공식적인 논의는 하지 않았다. 조국혁신당 일부 당원들도 “조국을 빼고 조국혁신당을 얘기할 수가 있겠냐”며 반발하고 있다고 한다.)
